sentences.en: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
sentences.zh: 光阴似箭；果蝇喜欢香蕉。

sentences.en: Can you get this arrow out of my leg?
sentences.zh: 你能把这支箭从我的腿里拔出来吗？

sentences.en: The arrow whistled within three inches of his head.
sentences.zh: 那支箭嗖的一声从他头顶三英寸的地方飞过。

senses.zh: 箭，箭头；箭状物；箭头记号
以箭头指示；箭一般地飞向
